text: objectively it's a good app but the limit of 5 tasks for the free version is basically forcing us to pay
author: Elyott Martin
developer_reply: Thank you for your review. We understand that five tasks may not be enough for everyone. Unfortunately, maintaining and improving the app comes with real costs, which is why we had to limit the number of tasks for free users. We'd really appreciate it if you gave us another chance. 😊
